BEFORE YOUR FIRST REP

Good questions.
Clear answers.

I’m new to training. Is 10reps for me?

There is no experience requirement to request an invitation. The experience brings planning, exercise guidance and equipment information together, so you can find a starting point for your goals.

What if my schedule or equipment changes?

Connect Your Gym for equipment-aware planning, explore movement alternatives and adjust training or recovery days around your week.

When does the app launch?

There is no confirmed public launch date yet. Launch details will be shared with early-access invitations.

How do I get an invite?

Use “Request your invitation” to explore the signup flow. This preview does not send or save your details. Live invitation requests will be connected before launch.

Is it free?

Pricing and founding-member benefits will be confirmed before you accept an invitation.

Which devices are supported?

10reps is being designed for mobile. App Store and Google Play availability will be confirmed before launch.
